messages:
evan_fin: nightly usage reconciliation shows ~45 accounts billed lower than Stripe usage report. discrepancy ~ $1,120. looks concentrated on metered feature 'live-requests'.

maya_eng: saw the usage-aggregation job logged a "parse float" warning at 02:10 UTC. stack shows it coerced quantities to integers when the usage had 0.5 granularity from the proxy.

ricardo_sre: infra note: the aggregator was recently changed to use a faster CSV parser (v2). that parser defaulted to int parsing for the 'quantity' column if no decimal point present. upstream proxy started emitting "0.5" as "0.5" in some batches and ".5" in others. the parser dropped leading dot decimals in some runs.

kate_fs: finance impact: metered charges for 45 customers missing fractional usage, revenue short ~ $1,120. Collections already emailed one customer about an underpayment. We need an official CSV and permission to run a corrective invoicing job.

maya_eng: mitigation: rolled back CSV parser to v1 for aggregation job and enabled strict float parsing. also added validation to reject rows where quantity parsing is ambiguous. turning on an alert for parse warnings > 0.1%.

evan_fin: please export affected customer list + invoice ids to /shared/finance/usage-incident/2280012345-usage-trunc.csv and include "manual-invoice-recalc-pending" in notes. requesting approval for corrective invoices up to $1.5k.

kate_fs: approve up to $1.5k for corrections. include audit notes and ticket ID when ready. :white_check_mark:

maya_eng: plan: 1) backfill aggregator with strict float parser in dry-run 2) produce staging adjustments table for finance 3) apply corrections after signoff. ETA ~3 hours. will post CSV when dry-run completes.
